title.title: The Correspondence of Esther Roberts Hunt Collins

msIdentifier.institution: Friends Historical Library of Swarthmore College

projectDesc.p: The correspondence of Quaker minister Esther Roberts Hunt Collins is stored at the Friends Historical Library of Swarthmore College. With the generous support of H. David and Joyce E. Hunt, Library staff scanned and transcribed these letters in 2024 and encoded the text in TEI.

div.p: having an unexpected conveyance this afternoon, thought I must scribble a little (although the) bearer was ready to leave before I began) and say it is a disappointment your not calling here— which I have made account of. You may expect it hath been a very safe proving season to me since our last parting. I expect you have heard of same of the circumstances attend thereon the first arrangement being frustrated has involved one much as my companion, C.L. at last gave out after David Grave had arranged matters for us to go together, and in one day of the times expecting to leave then, our carriage being to go home. Considerable repairs being necessary for his has prolonged the times as well as many other considerations intervening in the time, that has made the thing increasingly exercising. I crave your continued sympathy and petitions for my preservation, & we none expect to leave this on third day morning next. Conclude with near love to you & your dear children here—

postscript.p: P.S. my love to Uncle J. Hunt & other inquiring friends in our our parts & Matlock there remembrance is desirable
